kurz: The simplest technique in the kitchen: remove water from the surface before it gets hot.
bild_im_kopf: Like a wet match: only once it is dry will it light.
was_passiert: Every drop on the surface has to evaporate before the temperature can rise above 100 °C. That costs time and heat. If the surface is dry, browning begins straight away.
warum_wichtig: Applies equally to meat, fish, potatoes, vegetables and poultry skin.
schritte: Pat all over with kitchen paper or a clean cloth.
With potatoes, after soaking also let them air-dry briefly.
Only then toss with oil or spices.
